meta.title: Code Toolkit
meta.description: Five commands that work with no arguments: review inspects the current branch against its base and never writes; simplify and scrub cover the whole project and write by default (add report for a plan only); caption continues the task already in the conversation; pua uses the default flavor. Add sub to run in an isolated agent instead. Prompts are organised as a layered skill-style tree, with a deterministic test suite and a model evaluation loop.
